fee_notes: Standard Initial Franchise Fee is $5,000 USD, paid in full at signing of Franchise Agreement and is nonrefundable. A discounted fee of $2,500 applies to certain former Implementers in the United States who left and rejoined the EOS Implementer Community within five years of leaving. Canadian franchisees pay $5,000 CAD. Australian franchisees pay $5,000 AUD and UK/Netherlands franchisees pay £5,000. New franchisees in master franchise territories pay the same fee as US franchisees. Note: A separate Boot Camp Fee of $45,000 (USD) is also required at signing and is not included in the Initial Franchise Fee range reported here.
raw_excerpt:
You must pay us an initial franchise fee of $5,000 (the "Initial Franchise Fee") to obtain a franchise. You will pay the Initial Franchise Fee in full at the time you sign your Franchise Agreement. The Initial Franchise Fee is deemed fully earned upon payment and is paid in consideration of administrative and other expenses we incur in granting this franchise and therefore is nonrefundable under our Franchise Agreement.

We have discounted the Initial Franchise Fee to $2,500 for certain former Implementers in the United States who have left and then rejoined the EOS Implementer Community within five years of leaving.
